hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting the health of the global franchise network. In an asset-light model where 97% of units are franchised, system-wide sales (franchised + company-operated) represent the best indicator of the business's size and performance.

kpis.explanation_en: Total sales from all restaurants, franchised and company-operated.
kpis.description: Includes sales from franchised and company-operated restaurants. This is the basis for royalties received by YUM.
kpis.signal: Key metric for franchised companies: shows the size of the overall business.

kpis.explanation_en: Percentage of restaurants operated by independent franchisees.
kpis.description: In 2025, 97% of 63,285 restaurants were operated by franchisees or licensees.
kpis.signal: Highly asset-light model: YUM focuses on brand and royalties.

kpis.explanation_en: Total number of restaurants in the global network.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, YUM had 63,285 restaurants across its four concepts (KFC, Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, Habit Burger Grill).
kpis.signal: Massive global network operating in 155 countries and territories.

kpis.description: KFC is the portfolio's cornerstone with 33,897 units operating in 149 countries, 99% of which are franchised.
kpis.signal: KFC represents 54% of total portfolio (33,897 out of 63,285 units) and 90% of international units.

kpis.explanation_en: Ongoing evaluation of strategic options for the Pizza Hut brand.
kpis.description: Launched in 2025, this strategic review aims to determine the optimal approach to maximize Pizza Hut's value as a leader in the fragmented pizza market. Results expected in 2026.
kpis.signal: Value creation opportunity for YUM, Pizza Hut, and its franchisees by leveraging brand recognition and scale.

kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 8.2 Bn EUR in the latest year

kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 13.19 Bn EUR in the latest year

risks.title: Cybersecurity

risks.summary_en: YUM has implemented formal cybersecurity risk management processes, including a Data Incident Response Plan and dedicated oversight committees.
risks.score_rationale: The company integrates cybersecurity risk management into its overall risk management processes. The Audit Committee oversees technology and information security risks, and the CISO regularly reports to the Committee and the Board.

risks.summary_en: YUM faces potential litigation that could affect its operations and financial results.

risks.score_rationale_en: The company is involved in various potential disputes involving franchisees, suppliers, employees, customers, governments, and other parties, which could negatively impact results.

risks.score_rationale_en: YUM operates in a highly competitive market with other major restaurant chains and quick-service concepts, which could impact its market share and sales.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance

risks.summary_en: Increasing regulatory compliance in food, environmental, and labor areas could affect operating costs and the franchise model structure.

risks.score_rationale_en: YUM is subject to numerous government regulations regarding food safety, environmental protection, employee rights, and franchise operations, which could increase costs.

risks.summary_en: YUM's global presence in 155 countries exposes the company to rising geopolitical risks that could affect regional operations and financial results.

risks.score_rationale_en: YUM operates in 155 countries and territories, exposing it to geopolitical risks including government changes, conflicts, economic sanctions, and political instability.

risks.title: Brand Reputation
risks.summary: Protecting brand reputation and maintaining consumer trust are critical to preserving sales, growth, and franchise network value.
risks.summary_en: Protecting brand reputation and maintaining consumer trust are critical to preserving sales, growth, and franchise network value.
risks.score_rationale: The KFC, Taco Bell, and Pizza Hut brands are sensitive to reputation and consumer trust. Food safety incidents, scandals, or quality issues could severely impact sales.
risks.score_rationale_en: The KFC, Taco Bell, and Pizza Hut brands are sensitive to reputation and consumer trust. Food safety incidents, scandals, or quality issues could severely impact sales.
